jobs.title: Director of Solutions Engineering - EMEA
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

The Team

Airwallex is seeking a visionary and strategic leader to become our Director, Solutions Engineering. This is a critical leadership role responsible for leading our world-class solution engineering organisation across EMEA. This includes executive level pre-sales technical solution design, E2E solution implementation as well as proper post go-live commercial performance ramp-up for selective clients.

You will be the driving force behind our technical go-to-market (GTM) strategy, scaling a high-performing team of Solutions Engineers and Solutions Architects who are instrumental in driving our global revenue growth. By partnering with Sales, Product, and Engineering leadership, you will shape the customer experience, influence our product roadmap, and solidify Airwallex's position as the leading financial infrastructure for modern businesses.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, mentor, and scale our high-performing EMEA Solutions Engineering teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, and collaboration.

  • Develop and execute the global vision and strategy for the Solutions Engineering function, ensuring tight alignment with the company's overall sales and growth objectives.

  • Own the technical sales strategy, empowering your team to deliver compelling product demonstrations, proofs-of-concept (POCs), and sophisticated solution designs that solve our customers' most complex challenges.

  • Serve as a key executive partner to the Sales and Product organisations, acting as the voice of the customer and the field to influence the product roadmap and GTM strategy.

  • Implement scalable processes, playbooks, and best practices for the entire pre-sales and implementation lifecycle, from technical discovery and solutioning to RFP responses and guiding successful implementations.

  • Represent Airwallex as a senior technical leader in key customer meetings, industry events, and executive briefings, building trust and credibility with C-level stakeholders.

Who You Are

  • You have a significant track record of leading and scaling global or multi-regional Presales, Sales Engineering, or Solutions Architecture teams within EMEA, with 3+ years in a senior leadership capacity.

  • You bring 10+ years of experience in technical, client-facing roles. You have a background in engineering, software development, or product, and have been hands-on designing and delivering complex software solutions.

  • You are a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles, go-to-market motions, and how to position a technical solution to solve core business problems.

  • You excel at working with enterprise clients, understanding their business goals, and translating their needs into tangible, creative solutions built upon a sophisticated API-driven platform.

  • You possess outstanding executive communication and presentation skills, capable of commanding a room and articulating complex technical concepts to both commercial and engineering audiences.

  • Strong knowledge of the payments ecosystem, financial services, or Fintech is highly advantageous.

  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline preferred (Computer Science, Engineering, etc.)

This role is based in London

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Customer Success
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Success to lead our UKI team within the Large and High Growth segment. Joining our Customer Experience department, you will be responsible for executing our regional CS strategy, driving team performance, and ensuring an exceptional experience for our most strategic UKI customers.

In this role, you will directly manage, coach, and scale a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Your mission is to operationalise our customer success motions, ensuring your team successfully drives product adoption, value realisation, retention, and expansion across their portfolios.

This role is ideal for an experienced B2B SaaS or Fintech people leader who thrives in fast-paced environments. You should bring a strong execution discipline, a commercial mindset, and a passion for frontline coaching to help your team turn complex customer challenges into simple, impactful solutions.

 

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director, Customer Success (large and high growth) and leading a dedicated regional team of CSMs. The team is highly collaborative and dedicated to retain the largest customers of Pleo. You’ll also have the chance to work closely with UKI commercial team, account managers, customer support, onboarding, product and RevOps to ensure customer risk is addressed early and growth opportunities are maximised

 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Manager of Customer Success, you will:

  • Lead and coach a team of 10 CSMs, providing active coaching, career development, and daily operational guidance to ensure consistent, high-quality performance.

  • Own your team’s core metrics.

  • Implement and iterate on segment-specific success plans, engagement motions, renewal readiness playbooks, and risk-mitigation strategies.

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure seamless customer transitions, aligned account strategies, and coordinated execution during renewals and expansion plays.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for UKI strategic accounts, working cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Operations to eliminate friction points.

  • Use operational insights, data dashboards, and forecasting metrics to track team productivity, evaluate portfolio health, and proactively address churn risks.

Immediate priorities you can expect to tackle:

  • Strengthening localised account health visibility and proactive risk intervention.

  • Building high-impact execution habits across your team of 10 CSMs.

  • Improving renewal readiness and commercial handoffs with the UKI Sales teams.

  • Fostering a culture of accountability, continuous feedback, and performance excellence.

 

What You Bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, with a proven track record of 2+ years directly managing high-performing teams in B2B SaaS, fintech, or fast-paced technology environments.

  • Strong experience supporting large, mid-market, or enterprise-level accounts with complex stakeholders and sophisticated commercial needs.

  • A strong commercial acumen - you seamlessly connect day-to-day customer health to retention, expansion, and long-term business value.

  • Deep familiarity with Customer Success methodologies, customer lifecycles, health scoring, and risk mitigation tools.

  • Excellent people leadership skills with a proven ability to hire, inspire, hold accountable, and develop talent.

  • A data-driven approach, comfortable utilising CRM and CS tooling (e.g.Hubspot, Vitally) to drive team performance and forecasting.

  • Fluency in English with exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Other languages are a plus

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience in fintech, spend management, payments, or financial operations verticals.

  • Experience scaling team structures from smaller cohorts to larger regional pods.

 

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love combining frontline coaching with commercial strategy

  • You thrive in high-velocity, evolving environment

  • You want to make a highly visible, regional impact

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer a steady, predictable corporate routine

  • You want to step away from the frontline

  • You view Customer Success as purely “customer happiness"

 

How You’ll Develop in this Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Establish a highly cohesive, high-performing UKI CS team structure for our CSMs.

  • Deliver measurable improvements in UKI customer retention, renewal execution, and expansion pipelines.

  • Build a deep understanding of our product ecosystem to successfully advocate for the needs of our UKI market.

  • Be recognized as a vital execution partner to our Director of CS and a champion for our large and high-growth customer base.

 

Location

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 mins interview with the hiring manager to deep dive into your experience and what you can bring to the team

  3. Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take-home test to showcase your onboarding strategy and data driven approach and invite you to a 60 mins team interview to present your challenge and to know part of the team

  4. Final Interview: Final conversation with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Manager, Customer Success, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

Design how people use AI in real product workflows. This role focuses on building HCI interfaces where users can understand, guide, correct, and stay in control of AI systems that reason and act across multiple steps.

Current UX patterns are not enough for proactive AI products. You will help define new interaction models for how users work with AI, review progress, recover from mistakes, and build trust in the system.

  • Design end-to-end user experiences for AI product surfaces, from concept to shipped product.

  • Create interaction patterns for human-AI workflows, including prompting, review, confirmation, correction, handoff, and recovery.

  • Design interfaces that help users understand what the AI is doing, what it knows, what it is unsure about, and what will happen next.

  • Turn complex, multi-step AI capabilities into flows that are clear, controllable, and usable in everyday contexts.

  • Work closely with product, engineering, and ML teams to define problems, test ideas, and ship quickly.

  • Produce wireframes, flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs for web and mobile.

  • Run lightweight user research and usability tests to identify friction, trust issues, and failure points.

  • Help define reusable HCI design patterns as the product and design system mature.

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a product designer or UX designer, with a portfolio across web or mobile products.

  • Strong skills in interaction design, information hierarchy, and prototyping.

  • Proficiency in Figma and fast iteration workflows.

  • Experience working closely with product managers and engineers in fast-moving teams.

  • Comfort working with ambiguity and shaping solutions before requirements are fully defined.

  • Good judgment on usability, edge cases, and failure handling.

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team.   • Stay in the know of wellbeing trends, brand innovation, and cultural moments.

  • Actively contribute creative ideas in brainstorms and concept development sessions.

  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, meeting deadlines without compromising quality.

  • Work with influencers, content partners, and other talent to bring social-first concepts to life.

  • Support paid social by adapting and repurposing top-performing organic content into ad-ready formats.

  • Collaborate with the paid social/performance team to ensure creative learnings and platform trends inform both the organic and paid content pipelines.

What You Will Bring:

  • 4+ years of experience in social content production, digital media, or a related creative role.

  • Proficient in Final Cut Pro and Adobe Photoshop; strong command of Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, and Lightroom.

  • Deep understanding of social content best practices and what makes content successful across specific platforms.

  • Proven ability to translate strategic briefs into premium, on-brand visual content.

  • Strong visual storytelling sensibility and a keen eye for design, motion, and editorial quality.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Comfortable presenting ideas to cross-functional teams.

  • Strong project management instincts with the ability to prioritise across multiple workstreams.

The Deal

We ask a great deal of the people who work here. We expect full ownership and a genuine commitment to give this chapter everything you have.

If the most important work of your career is ahead of you, this is the place to do it.

jobs.title: Junior Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Junior Automation Specialist

About the Role

Customer Care at Perk is being rebuilt around automation and AI. This role is for someone who likes taking a messy operational problem and turning it into something that runs in production.

As an Automation Specialist, you'll design and ship the systems that cut manual work, make agents faster, and improve what customers actually experience. You'll work across Make.com, Airtable, Zendesk, Claude, APIs, and whatever else the problem needs. Some days that's a workflow. Some days it's an AI tool with evals, guardrails, and a kill switch. The through-line is the same: get it from idea to live, then keep it reliable.

You'll partner with Operational Excellence, Customer Care Leadership, and Operations. You'll own delivery end to end, and you'll be measured on whether the things you build actually stick.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, test, and deploy solutions across Make.com, Airtable, Zendesk, Claude, APIs, and AI tooling.

  • Wire up multi-system integrations that remove real manual effort, not just move it around.

  • Own projects from the first sketch through production and ongoing improvement.

  • Stand up proper testing and validation environments so "it worked in my scenario" isn't the bar.

  • Turn business problems into technical designs, and flag new automation opportunities as you go.

  • Stay close after launch: watch adoption, fix what breaks, iterate on what underperforms

Build

  • Write automations that are maintainable, documented, and safe for someone else to pick up.

  • Monitor production systems, debug fast, and keep operational impact low when things go wrong.

  • Know when Make/Zapier-class tools are enough, and when the problem needs a different approach.

  • Keep an eye on new automation and AI capabilities, and bring the useful ones in deliberately.

Raise the bar

  • Be the person others ask when they're stuck on architecture, platform limits, or how to ship AI safely.

  • Review builds before they go live when that review actually reduces risk..

  • Create reusable components, patterns, and standards so the next build is faster and cleaner.

Teamwork

  • Sit with Opex and Operations until you understand the real problem, then design the right fix.

  • Shape discovery and scoping so solutions stay practical and maintainable.

  • Keep stakeholders clear on progress, risks, dependencies, and dates.

  • Feed operational feedback back into the next version.

What We're Looking For

  • Shipped production automations on Make.com, Zapier, Claude, or similar not just demos.

  • Worked with Airtable or comparable systems as a real ops backbone, not a side spreadsheet.

  • Built LLM-powered workflows with prompt craft, evaluation, and guardrails — and knows when the model shouldn't act alone.

  • Strong at debugging production systems under time pressure.

  • Can turn a fuzzy business request into something scalable and supportable.

  • Comfortable working with both technical and operational partners.

  • Prefers speed and ambiguity over perfect specs.

How We'll Know You're Winning

  • Automations that meaningfully cut manual work in Customer Care.

  • Multi-system builds that stay reliable once they're live.

  • High reliability, performance, and adoption — not just "launched".

  • Clear gains in operational efficiency, agent experience, and customer experience.

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Interview Process

Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual
Hiring Manager interview - 30-45mins Virtual
Assessment Interview - 30-60mins - In-person interview

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

#LI-Hybrid

jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

About DeepL Voice

DeepL Voice is shaping the future of real-time multilingual communication.

Built on DeepL’s world-leading translation quality, the Voice product line brings together Research, Engineering, Product, and GTM teams to deliver real-time speech-to-speech interpretation for meetings, live conversations, and developer integrations.

In just two years, DeepL Voice has launched its first customer-facing products and built reliable, low-latency real-time systems. We are now scaling globally—expanding adoption, opening new use cases, and defining a new product category in multilingual communication.

The Role

As a Senior Sales Specialist (Voice Product Evangelist), you will help bring DeepL Voice to market at scale.

This is a customer-facing GTM role focused on supporting sales teams across the DACH region, leading Voice-specific customer conversations, and helping organisations understand and adopt real-time translation. You will work closely with Core Account Executives, Product, and Marketing to shape how Voice is positioned, demonstrated, and sold.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Account Executives on Voice-related opportunities across enterprise customers

  • Lead Voice-specific discovery, demos, pilots, and customer presentations

  • Act as a subject-matter expert across DeepL Voice use cases (meetings, live conversations, APIs)

  • Support the creation and evolution of Voice sales materials, talk tracks, and playbooks

  • Enable sales teams through training sessions, deal support, and hands-on guidance

  • Represent DeepL Voice in customer meetings, workshops, and strategic engagements

  • Gather customer and field feedback to inform product positioning and roadmap discussions

What You Bring

  • 6–10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, in an Account Executive or Specialist Sales role

  • Experience selling complex or emerging products that require customer education

  • Strong presentation and communication skills with both technical and business audiences

  • Ability to clearly articulate product value and real-world use cases

  • Comfort working cross-functionally in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

  • Experience selling Voice-related technology, such as Conversational AI, Real-Time Systems, or Communication technologies (Contact Centre, CCaaS, Unified Comms) plus API solution experience

  • Fluency in English and German

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-JW2

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity to be a key member of our core Finance team in London. As a Finance Transformation Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening our core accounting capabilities and shaping the future of our financial processes. You will be instrumental in delivering critical transformation projects, with a specific focus on building out our Transactional Ledger and achieving an accelerated financial close for Checkout. If you are a proactive and data-savvy finance professional with a passion for process improvement, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Project Delivery & Support: Support and drive key workstreams within finance transformation projects, ensuring tasks are completed on time and to a high standard. You will be actively involved in the end-to-end project lifecycle, from analysis to implementation.

  • Process Optimisation: Use data analysis to scrutinise existing "as-is" accounting processes, particularly those related to the financial close and transactional ledger, to quantitatively identify inefficiencies and control gaps. You will help design and implement standardised and scalable "to-be" processes.

  • Change Management: Contribute to change management activities by preparing documentation, supporting user training sessions, and acting as a point of contact for queries to ensure smooth transitions and user adoption of new processes and systems.

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate effectively with various stakeholders across local and global finance teams. Build strong working relationships to ensure project alignment and support successful outcomes.

  • Governance & Control: Support the implementation and maintenance of a robust control framework for all new processes, ensuring compliance with internal policies and international accounting standards (e.g., IFRS).

  • Performance Monitoring: Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to help measure the success of transformation initiatives and ensure project benefits are realised.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong Accounting Knowledge: A professional accounting qualification (ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or equivalent) is mandatory. You must have a solid understanding of core accounting principles, month-end close procedures, and financial controls.

  • Data Analytics & BI Skills: Proficiency in working with large, complex datasets is essential. Experience with data analytics tools is highly advantageous, particularly:

    • SQL for data querying and manipulation.

    • Python (especially libraries like Pandas) for data analysis.

    • Business Intelligence packages such as Looker or Power BI for visualisation and reporting.

  • Proven Transformation Experience: Demonstrable experience contributing to finance change or process improvement projects within a fast-paced environment. Experience with financial close optimisation, general ledger systems, or process standardisation is highly desirable.

  • Strong Project & Organisational Skills: Proven ability to manage your own tasks and workstreams across multiple projects concurrently. You must be highly organised, detail-oriented, and adept at meeting deadlines.

  • Industry Experience: Prior experience in the Fintech or Payments industry is advantageous.

  • Excellent Stakeholder Management: Strong communication and interpersonal skills. You must be comfortable and credible when engaging with stakeholders at various levels of the organisation.

  • Resilience & Adaptability: A proactive, "can-do" attitude with the ability to thrive under pressure and navigate ambiguity. You are a natural problem-solver who sees challenges as opportunities.

  • Fluency in English is required.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

Skills

  • Technical Mastery: Highly proficient in Excel/G-Sheets; SQL experience is a plus.

  • SaaS Fluency: Deep understanding of SaaS economics and metrics (ARR, Churn, LTV/CAC).

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written English; German is a bonus but not required.

Mindset

  • The Interrogator: You don't just report numbers; you surface the story behind them and challenge assumptions at every level.

  • Bias to Action: You prefer a "shipped" automated solution over a "perfect" manual one.

  • Keep it Simple: You champion the value of simplicity, identifying process improvements and eliminating non-value-added tasks.

Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto

  • Best of Both Worlds: We live and breathe a flexible hybrid model. Our beautiful office at Hausvogteiplatz is our vibrant Berlin hub for collaboration, but you have the freedom to leverage the setup that works best for you.

  • Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. Once you have completed your probation, you have the option to work remotely from within Europe for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired.

  • Multicultural & Inclusive Team: We thrive on diverse perspectives. Our international team fosters a culture of mutual respect and professional exchange, ensuring that fresh ideas and tolerance are at the heart of everything we build together.

jobs.description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.
 
Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab.


Functions of the Role

As Director of Systems Delivery, you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. 

You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments.

We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements.

  • Full-Stack System Execution: Lead the Systems Delivery capability to execute internal full-stack system deployments, bridging physical hardware with full-stack software from assembly through customer handover.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate across hardware, software, product, and operations teams to align physical hardware build schedules with software release cycles, managing dependency interfaces and trade-offs.

  • Site Infrastructure Readiness: Oversee internal and customer site infrastructure preparation to ensure physical environments are ready for deployment.

  • Acceptance Testing & Governance: Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols.

  • Service & Operational Handoff: Establish post-installation support frameworks, handovers, and field engineering processes to guarantee long-term operational uptime.

  • Process Standardisation: Build scalable playbooks, quality standards, and repeatable processes for integration, validation, and operational readiness. 

  • Supply Chain Management: Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines.                                                                  

  • Commercial Scoping Support: Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability.


Experience - Essentials

  • Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times.

  • Demonstrated background managing hardware-software integration, physical systems validation, and site-installation constraints.

  • Experience building, managing, and mentoring hardware, systems integration, or field delivery teams.

  • Track record of taking first-of-a-kind physical hardware platforms from prototype to repeatable deployment models.

  • Hands-on experience managing facility readiness and running structured customer acceptance protocols.

  • Strong project management expertise tracking HW/SW critical paths, project budgets, risk registers, and executive reporting.

  • Direct experience overseeing technical vendors, supplier selection, and component procurement.

  • Strong communication skills with key stakeholders, including executive, technical, and customer audiences. Willingness and eligibility to travel internationally to customer sites as required.


Experience - Desirable

  • Direct technical background in quantum computing systems, cryogenic systems, silicon platforms, or HPC architectures.

  • Experience establishing post-delivery field support, service handoffs, or customer support operations for complex hardware.

  • Experience scaling system assembly and delivery operations within a deep-tech environment. Experience supporting hardware/software technical scoping for commercial proposals.


Benefits

  • Be part of a creative, world-leading team

  • Competitive salary and share options scheme

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Group private medical insurance scheme

  • Life Assurance

  • Cycle-to-work Scheme 

  • Central London location


EEO Statement

Quantum Motion is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate based on age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, colour, religion, disability status, marital status, pregnancy, gender reassignment or any other protected characteristics covered by the Equality Act 2010.

About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

The Opportunity

This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature.

The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, six to nine months, with typical initial values of £25k- £100k and clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning takes a business case, not a demonstration and it requires strong discovery, quantified value, access to senior decision-makers and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT and finance.

Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product and senior executive support, not an unproven proposition.

Why Strong Sellers Join Singu

  • A defined territory and named-account set, not an undifferentiated geographic patch.

  • Enterprise deals with meaningful initial value and clear multi-country expansion potential.

  • Dedicated business development, Pre-Sales, marketing and executive sponsorship.

  • Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching and fast commercial decisions. Pricing, terms and sponsorship all take place without a committee.

  • Uncapped earnings with meaningful accelerators for over-performance.

  • Credible routes into strategic or global accounts or sales leadership.

What You Will Own

Pipeline and Coverage

  • A new business quota, and a territory plan that shows how you intend to hit it.

  • Pipeline built through business development, marketing, partner and self-generated activity, with personal responsibility for coverage across the territory.

  • Diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance and risk.

Deal Execution

  • Opportunities qualified to a MEDDICC standard, with a quantified business case and access to the economic buyer.

  • Every material deal multi-threaded, so it survives a change of sponsor.

  • Commercial negotiation that builds value and protects price rather than defaulting to discount.

  • Rigorous qualification and early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process or route to decision.

Land and Expand

  • First wins scoped so they can grow: sites, countries and use cases sequenced from the start.

  • A clean handover to Customer Success, with the expansion path documented.

Forecasting and Governance

  • A forecast that holds, with stage integrity, next steps and close dates you stand behind.

  • Risk surfaced early, with an honest view of what changed and what is needed.

  • Contribution to the playbook i.e. objections, competitive intelligence and repeatable use cases.

What Excellent Performance Looks Like

Commercial outcomes

  • New-logo ARR against quota

  • Pipeline creation and territory coverage

  • Win rate, against incumbents and against no decision

  • Average deal value and total multi-year value

  • Strategic logos won

Operating standards

  • Forecast accuracy and stage integrity

  • Multi-threading and MEDDICC quality

  • Price protection and discount discipline

  • CRM quality and process discipline

Your First 12 Months

  • First 90 days: complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage and create the first qualified opportunities.

  • By six months: credible coverage against ramped quota, multi-threaded opportunities progressing through evaluation, and a first customer win closed or materially advanced.

  • By 12 months: delivery against ramped quota, a repeatable pipeline-creation motion in your territory, and accounts landed with clear expansion potential.

What We’re Looking For

  • Typically five or more years in B2B software or complex technology sales, including a sustained period carrying a new business quota. Quality of results matters more than years.

  • Evidence of sustained over-performance in new business sales: quota attainment, team ranking, pipeline personally created and representative deals won. We will ask for specifics.

  • The ability to take us through significant deals end to end: how the opportunity was created, how the buying group developed, what changed, and why it was won or lost.

  • English and German languages at business level. Hard requirement.

  • A structured seller: MEDDICC or comparable, used in practice.

  • Strong results combined with the forecast and CRM discipline to run a predictable business.

  • CAFM, IWMS, FM, PropTech or multi-site operations experience is an advantage.

Package, Support and Progression

  • Competitive base salary uncapped commission, accelerators for over-performance.

  • Business development coverage, Pre-Sales, marketing and enablement to support your success

  • Structured onboarding, methodology training and deal coaching, with a fairly ramped quota.

  • Progression into a global accounts or sales leadership. We back elite individual contributors as readily as future managers.

This role is for an accomplished new business seller who wants the autonomy to build a territory, the support to win complex enterprise deals and real reward for over-performance. If you have created pipeline, won meaningful customers and run a disciplined process, we would like to hear from you.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

jobs.title: VP/Head of Engineering (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Volle technische Verantwortung für Rocket — direkt an die Gründer, ohne Zwischenebene

tack von Marriott. Unsere Engineers arbeiten also mitten im echten Hotelbetrieb, nicht gegen Sandbox-APIs.

In dieser Rolle verantwortest du Engineering bei MICE DESK — vollständig. Es gibt keine CTO-Ebene über dir: Architektur, Technik, Delivery und Team liegen bei dir, und du berichtest direkt an die Gründer. Das ist eine Hands-on-Führungsrolle. Du führst das Engineering-Team inklusive unserer AI-/Data-Funktion, verantwortest die Schnittstelle zu Product und stehst für alles gerade, was ausgeliefert wird.


  • Engineering, end-to-end. Architektur, System-Design, Delivery gegen die Roadmap, Zuverlässigkeit, technische Schuld. Backend, Frontend, DevOps, QA und das AI-/Data-Team laufen bei dir zusammen. Du setzt schlanke Prozesse, mit denen ein kleines Team schnell liefert, ohne Dinge zu zerbrechen.
  • Eine AI-gestützte Engineering-Pipeline. Wir bauen nicht nur AI-Produkte — wir bauen mit AI. Du machst die Engineering-Organisation selbst AI-nativ: agentische Coding-Workflows, AI-gestützte Reviews und Tests, Automatisierung von allem Wiederkehrenden. Ein kleines Team soll liefern wie ein dreimal so großes — das wahr zu machen ist dein Job.
  • AI als Kernfähigkeit des Systems. Du architektierst die Integration von LLMs und agentischen Workflows in Produktivsysteme: deterministische Logik kombiniert mit AI-generierten Ergebnissen, mit echter Validierung, Fallbacks und Zuverlässigkeitsstrategien. Der Hotelbetrieb läuft auf unserer Plattform — Nicht-Determinismus ist keine Entschuldigung für Unzuverlässigkeit.
  • Das Team. Einstellen, entwickeln, skalieren. Du übernimmst ein starkes kleines Team und machst daraus eine leistungsstarke Engineering-Organisation mit einer Kultur aus Ownership und Tempo. Auch unsere verteilte Hiring-Strategie über mehrere Standorte hinweg liegt bei dir.
  • Product- und Business-Alignment. Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und Product. Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, vereinfachst Komplexität und verbindest Engineering-Arbeit mit Ergebnissen: Umsatz, Automatisierung, Kundenwirkung. Mit dem US-Markteintritt muss Engineering mit Enterprise-Kunden auf zwei Kontinenten Schritt halten.

Woran wir Erfolg messen:

  • 6 Monate: Delivery ist planbar, die AI-gestützte Dev-Pipeline läuft, und das Team ist um A-Player gewachsen, die du eingestellt hast.
  • 12 Monate: Die Plattform skaliert mit US-Enterprise-Kunden, die Kernsysteme sind zuverlässig und observierbar, und Engineering ist ein Wettbewerbsvorteil — kein Flaschenhals.

Ehrlich gesagt: Das ist volle Verantwortung ohne Netz darüber. Keine CTO-Ebene, die Entscheidungen abnimmt oder abfängt — die Architektur, das Team und alles, was ausgeliefert wird, sind deins. Wenn du eine Rolle suchst, in der jemand über dir die Richtung vorgibt, ist das nicht deine Stelle. Wenn du genau diese Verantwortung willst, ist es die richtige.


Dein Profil

  • 10+ Jahre Software Engineering, davon 5+ in einer Engineering-Führungsrolle in wachstumsstarken Produktunternehmen.
  • Starker Hands-on-Hintergrund in Backend oder Full-Stack — du kannst noch selbst in die Tiefe gehen.
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung, Engineering-Teams in wachsenden Startups zu skalieren.
  • Starke Architektur-Expertise: APIs, verteilte Systeme, Event-Driven Design, Cloud.
  • LLM-/agentische AI-Systeme in Produktion — und eine echte Überzeugung, dass Engineering selbst AI-gestützt gehört.
  • Product-Mindset: Du verbindest technische Entscheidungen mit geschäftlichen Ergebnissen.
  • Souverän im Umgang mit Ambiguität, Tempo und voller Verantwortung.

Ein Pluspunkt, kein Muss: Hintergrund in Hospitality-Tech, CRM, PMS oder Revenue Management. Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Integrationen (Salesforce, Oracle OPERA Cloud, Microsoft Graph API). Erfahrung in der Führung verteilter, internationaler Teams.


Warum wir?

Wir sind das Technologieunternehmen, das den Gruppen- und Veranstaltungsverkauf in der Hotellerie neu denkt. Was heute über Posteingang, Excel und Telefon läuft, macht unsere Plattform Rocket zu einem durchgängigen, KI-gestützten Prozess — von der ersten Anfrage bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag. Europäische Hotelgruppen führen ihren Gruppenverkauf bereits darüber.
Das bedeutet für dich: Du arbeitest nicht trotz KI, sondern mit ihr. Wer bei uns anfängt, gibt Feedback, das in Produktentscheidungen einfließt — und versteht irgendwann, warum ein Prompt besser funktioniert als ein anderer.
Und weil wir schnell wachsen, ist vieles bei uns noch im Entstehen. Manche Antwort lautet ehrlicherweise „das bauen wir gerade noch”. Genau darin liegt die Chance: Du triffst auf Freiräume statt auf fertige Strukturen, und was du hier aufbaust, trägt deine Handschrift.

Was wir bieten

  • Arbeit mit echter KI-Technologie auf internationalem Niveau — nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Geschäftsmodell.
  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum. Deine Ideen landen nicht in einem Ideenbriefkasten, sondern in der nächsten Iteration.
  • Kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen in Tagen, nicht in Gremienschleifen.
  • Wachstum, das du mitgehst. Wir bauen gerade die nächste Unternehmensphase — mit Rollen, Verantwortung und Perspektiven, die es vor einem Jahr noch nicht gab.
  • Hauptarbeitsort Leipzig mit regelmäßiger Büropräsenz und flexiblem Homeoffice-Anteil. Hybride Modelle sind bei uns gelebte Praxis, nicht die Ausnahme.
  • Unbefristeter Vertrag, Vollzeit.
  • Leistungsprämien für nachweisbare Erfolge.
  • Mehrtägige Teamevents an Orten, die tatsächlich Spaß machen.
So läuft unser Bewerbungsprozess
  1. Intro-Interview — wir lernen uns kennen, du erfährst, wo wir stehen und wohin wir wollen.
  2. Leadership Study oder Technical Study, je nach Rolle — ein echtes Problem aus unserem Alltag, das wir gemeinsam durchgehen.
  3. Founder Interview

jobs.description:
Shape the future of real-world LiDAR applications at a leading high-tech company in Munich.

At Blickfeld, we develop our own innovative LiDAR technology based on a frictionless MEMS mirror. Our sensors create 3D data of the environment in high resolution. These 3D point clouds contain detailed information about the exact size, position and speed of objects which allows us to analyze the shape and movement of people, vehicles and other objects. Blickfeld LiDAR sensors excel in a wide variety of applications, e.g. security, volume measurement and traffic management, and smart cities.

As part of our innovative software team, you will contribute to the integration of our LiDAR sensors into modern security environments. After an onboarding phase, you will work on interoperability testing, system integrations, and the development of device software components with a high degree of autonomy.

Tasks

System Integration: You test the interoperability of our LiDAR devices with various Video Management Systems (VMS) and Video Surveillance (CCTV) platforms to ensure seamless integration into existing security environments.

Testing Environment Maintenance: You maintain and extend the testing environment used for validating device integrations, including installation and configuration of VMS platforms, and troubleshooting of the test infrastructure.

Software Development: You contribute to the development and maintenance of our device integration stack by implementing, integrating, and debugging software components running on the device.

Validation & Documentation: You document integration results, compliance findings, and system behavior to support interoperability improvements and product development.

Requirements

Education: You are currently studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or a comparable technical field.

Programming Skills: You have solid experience with Python and TypeScript. You are familiar with object-oriented design principles and comfortable working in complex development environments.

Automated Testing: You have experience with testing frameworks such as PyTest and understand modern testing practices. You are capable of manually counting points within the 3D point cloud space.

Technical Stack (Plus): Experience with one or more of the following technologies is a plus: GitLab, Docker, CI/CD tools, CMake, Asyncio, Protobuf, gRPC, RTSP, gStreamer, open6d, SOAP, Web Services, ONVIF.

Mindset: You enjoy solving technical problems and contributing to the development of reliable and robust software solutions.

Communication & Languages: You have fluent English skills and are comfortable collaborating in an international team.

Benefits

Purpose & Technology: You work on cutting-edge LiDAR technology that enables safer, smarter, and more efficient environments—from critical infrastructure to smart cities—while contributing directly to real-world impact.

jobs.title: (Senior) Customer Success Manager (alle Geschlechter)
jobs.description:
Deine High-Speed Mission

Zu Speed Kit

Speed Kit macht die Shops und Websites unserer Kunden messbar schneller, und schnellere Seiten heißen mehr Umsatz. Zu unseren Kunden gehören einige der bekanntesten E-Commerce-Marken in Deutschland und Europa.

Zu deiner Rolle

Customer Success bei uns ist deshalb keine Zufriedenheitsverwaltung, sondern die Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Kunde live geht, den Effekt auf sein Geschäft nachvollziehen kann und langfristig bleibt. Die initiale Unterschrift holen unsere Account Executives. Danach sitzt du im Driver Seat: Du bringst den Kunden durch Trial oder POC über die Ziellinie und behältst ihn anschließend in deinem Portfolio. Der Kunde bleibt deiner, mit allem was dazugehört.

Was du verantwortest

  • Du führst Trials und POCs deiner Neukunden: Du steuerst Integration und Konfiguration mit unserem Team und dem Kunden, koordinierst A/B-Test-Setup und Auswertung und hältst die Stakeholder zusammen. Du erkennst früh, wenn ein Projekt kippt, und drehst es. 

  • Du führst die Onboarding-Projekte als echte Projektleitung, von Kickoff über Go-live bis zur Ergebnispräsentation. Das ist der Schwerpunkt der Rolle.

  • Du betreust deine Bestandskunden aus eigenem Antrieb. Du gehst auf deine Accounts zu, bevor sie sich melden, kennst ihre Roadmap und ihre Relaunches und bringst regelmäßig Ergebnisse und Ideen an den Tisch.

  • Du trägst Umsatzverantwortung für dein Portfolio: Verlängerungen, Commitment-Upgrades, Überschreitungen, Ausbau in weitere Domains, Marken und Länder. Du weißt jederzeit, wo dein Book steht und warum. Und weil dein Erfolg unser Erfolg ist, profitierst du auch entsprechend davon.

  • Du führst Kundengespräche auf Basis von Daten: Core Web Vitals, CrUX, Conversion-Uplift, ROI. Du kannst einen Uplift erklären und auch eine Verschlechterung, ohne auszuweichen.

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit AI. Analysen, Reporting, Datenrecherche über unsere Systeme, Entwürfe für Kundenkommunikation: das machst du mit Claude und Gemini und baust dir eigene wiederverwendbare Workflows dafür. Wir erwarten kein Coding, aber wir erwarten, dass du dir selbst Hebel baust, statt Dinge manuell abzuarbeiten.

  • Du bist die Spinne im Netz. Niemand im Unternehmen weiß so viel über unsere Kunden wie du, und du bringst dieses Wissen in alle Teams, von Engineering und Product über Sales bis zur Geschäftsführung.


Wie es bei uns wirklich läuft

Das Customer Success Team ist eine kleine, extrem eingespielte Truppe und liefert unseren Kunden echten, messbaren Mehrwert. Das ist eine High-Impact-Rolle: Was du bewegst, ist sofort sichtbar, im Ergebnis des Kunden und in unseren Zahlen. Dazu extrem flache Hierarchien, kein Freigabetheater, direkte Gespräche mit Engineering, Product und Geschäftsführung. Was du entscheidest, gilt. Dafür brauchst du aber auch eine eigene Meinung und den Mut, sie auszusprechen. Wenn du etwas anders siehst, sagst du es, und du bleibst dabei, auch wenn jemand widerspricht.

Wir haben mehr Projekte als Hände. Ein Teil deiner Woche wird von außen bestimmt, deshalb ist gute Triage entscheidend: Du erkennst, welches der zehn offenen Themen heute Umsatz bewegt oder einen Kunden hält, und was warten kann. Du bekommst von uns Ziele, Kontext und Rückendeckung, aber niemand sortiert deine Prioritäten für dich. Dazu gehört auch, dass du den Mund aufmachst, wenn es brennt: nicht bei jeder Unsicherheit, sondern nachdem du selbst ernsthaft versucht hast, das Problem zu lösen. Keine Probleme, die drei Wochen im Stillen wachsen, und keine Eskalation für jede Frage, die du selbst beantworten könntest.


Dein Ticket für unser Raumschiff

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Customer Success oder Account Management im B2B SaaS

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung technischer Onboarding-, Trial- oder Implementierungsprojekte mit mehreren Stakeholdern auf Kundenseite

  • Erfahrung mit oder klare Bereitschaft zu echter Umsatzverantwortung. Du willst, dass dein Ergebnis an Kundenerfolg hängt, statt es zu vermeiden.

  • AI-Tools als tägliches Arbeitsmittel. Das ist harte Voraussetzung und kein Pluspunkt. Wir werden dich im Bewerbungsprozess bitten, konkret zu zeigen, was du mit Claude, Gemini oder vergleichbaren Tools gebaut oder automatisiert hast. "Ich nutze ChatGPT manchmal für E-Mails" reicht dafür nicht.

  • Selbstbewusstsein und Standing. Du trittst gegenüber Entscheidern auf Augenhöhe auf, führst auch unangenehme Gespräche über Preise, Verzögerungen und Erwartungen, und widersprichst einem Kunden freundlich, wenn er falsch liegt.

  • Digitale Tools sind für dich selbstverständlich. Ein neues System bringst du dir selbst bei, statt auf eine Schulung zu warten.

  • Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit und saubere Priorisierung unter Last

  • Zahlen- und Datenaffinität. Du arbeitest sicher mit Traffic- und Performance-Metriken und leitest daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher

Nice-to-have

  • Verständnis von Web Performance, Core Web Vitals und dem Google CrUX Report

  • Erfahrung mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren CRM

  • E-Commerce-Hintergrund, idealerweise mit Shopsystemen wie Shopify, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopware oder Magento


Warum einsteigen?


  • Wir richten dir deinen Arbeitsplatz ein - vom Bildschirm bis zum Bürostuhl

  • Wähle dein OS: Du kannst dein Betriebssystem frei wählen zwischen Mac, Windows oder Linux

  • Schönes Büro: Arbeiten im Herzen des Hamburger Schanzenviertels

  • Haustierfreundliches Büro: Du darfst gerne einen pelzigen Freund mitbringen

  • Tolle Kolleg:innen: Kompetentes und humorvolles Team

  • Flexibel arbeiten: Arbeite nach einem Vollzeit- oder Teilzeitplan

  • Flache Hierarchien: Die besten Ideen gewinnen, egal von wem

  • Event-Slots: Mehrmals im Jahr könnt ihr abstimmen, was gemacht wird - wolltest Du nicht schon immer mal mit deinen Kolleg:innen Kart fahren? Vote for it!

  • Speed.Fest: Wir treffen uns jedes Quartal alle gemeinsam in unserem HQ in Hamburg für Workshops, gutes Essen, Events und eine tolle Zeit

  • Persönliches Ausbildungsbudget: Wir helfen Dir, Deine Karriere und Deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen

  • Monatliches, flexibles Benefit Budget: 50€ pro Monat, dass Du frei auf das für Dich passende Benefit verteilen kannst - von ÖPNV über Shopping Gutscheine bis hin zur Gym-Mitgliedschaft

  • Zukunftssichere Altersvorsorge: Bringe deine Altersvorsorge mit oder lass dich von unseren Experten beraten


Countdown

4️⃣… Du teilst deinen Lebenslauf, dein LinkedIn oder Xing-Profil mit uns.

3️⃣… Wir vereinbaren ein erstes ausführliches (Video-)Gespräch mit unserem Head of Customer Success zum Kennenlernen (45~60 Minuten). 
Wenn wir beide großes Interesse haben, bekommst du danach eine Case-Study-Simulation aus unserem echten Arbeitsalltag. Aufwand: maximal 2 Stunden, mehr wollen wir dir nicht zumuten.

2️⃣… Wir vereinbaren ein Gespräch mit unserem Head of Customer Success und einem Mitglied des CSM-Teams, inklusive Präsentation deiner Case-Study-Simulation (60~90 Minuten).

1️⃣… Abschlussgespräch mit unserem CEO (ca. 30 Minuten). Passt es für beide Seiten, bereiten wir den Vertrag vor.

…0️⃣ Du steigst ein in unser Raumschiff!


Deine Ansprechperson

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
🌍 About Outpost

Global expansion is broken. Without a local entity, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce. Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we act as Merchant of Record, taking on tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're hiring a second Executive Assistant to support our CEO.

We already have an EA, and she isn't going anywhere. You'll report to the CEO and work alongside her: she keeps inbound, customer routing and the investor-facing side, takes diary, travel, logistics, internal admin, and hiring coordination. You'll join to take a defined set of workstreams off that plate.

Roughly 70% of this role is executive support. The other 30% is hiring - and that's where the leverage is. We run a five-stage interview loop across engineering, ops, product, GTM and tax, hiring around two people a month. Someone needs to own the machinery: scheduling across five calendars and four countries, keeping candidates warm, chasing feedback, making sure nobody good goes cold because a diary didn't line up.

This is a role for someone early in their career who is unusually organised and wants to learn how a company actually gets built. You won't be handed a finished process. You'll be shown how we do things today, and expected to make it better.

🧩 What You'll Do

Own the CEO's diary and logistics

  • Run scheduling day to day - booking, moving, protecting focus time, resolving clashes before they become problems

  • Book and manage international travel, and rebuild it when a flight moves

  • Prepare meeting packs: who's in the room, what they want, what happened last time

  • Track and chase the follow-ups nobody wrote down

Do the work he never sees

  • The highest-value work here is invisible. He shouldn't know it happened - he should just find the day went smoothly

  • Fix problems before they reach him: the double-booking, the missing dial-in, the visa that needed renewing

  • Do the quiet prep - background on a person he's meeting, what was agreed last time, the numbers checked before a deck goes out

  • Anticipate. If a trip is booked, the transfer, the dinner and the buffer around the flight are already handled

  • The fewer questions he has to ask you, the better you're doing the job

Own hiring coordination

  • Run scheduling across the full interview loop - five stages, multiple interviewers, several time zones

  • Keep the pipeline clean: trackers, interview feedback, stage-by-stage conversion

  • Build target lists for open roles and help manage outreach

  • Be the candidate's point of contact - fast, warm, human. How we treat candidates is how we're judged

  • Coordinate offers, references, contracts, start dates, and new-hire onboarding logistics

Keep the company running

  • Support board and investor prep alongside the CEO, Chief of Staff and our senior EA

  • Help run internal comms: all-hands, offsites, company updates

  • Manage supplier, tooling and expense admin so nobody else has to think about it

  • Spot the recurring problem and fix it permanently rather than solving it again next week

💥 Example Projects

  • Rebuild a full week of CEO travel in an afternoon after a fundraising meeting moves

  • Take time-to-offer from three weeks to ten days by fixing scheduling and feedback bottlenecks

  • Build the candidate tracker that shows conversion at every interview stage, and run it weekly

  • Own the logistics for a board meeting: pre-reads, agenda, materials, follow-ups

  • Organise a company offsite for a team split across London, Amsterdam and beyond

  • Write down how you do your job so the next person can pick it up in a week

🧱 What We're Looking For

Ideal background:

  • 1–3 years in an EA, team assistant, recruiting coordinator or ops support role - ideally at a startup or fast-growing tech / fintech company

  • Any recruiting coordination exposure is a plus, but we'll teach it if you're quick

  • Comfortable in a company without much process, because you've worked in one before

  • Fluent with modern tooling (Notion, Slack, Linear, ATS, scheduling tools and AI) and quick to pick up new ones

  • Excellent written English. You'll write on the CEO's behalf

Signals we care about:

  • Ridiculous bias for action - you solve, not observe

  • Extremely organised, and visibly so. Nothing gets dropped, nothing needs chasing twice

  • Strong EQ - you know how to read a room, a candidate, or a blocker

  • Sound judgement - you know what to decide yourself and what to escalate, and you sit on neither

  • Discreet. You'll see comp, term sheets and candidate conversations before most of the team

  • Curious and resourceful - you can figure anything out

  • You improve what you touch. The second time you do something, it should be faster than the first

What this role is not:

  • Not a diary-only role - you'll own hiring, onboarding and internal operations too

  • Not a pure recruiter role - hiring is a third of the job, not the whole of it

  • Not a role for someone who needs defined processes and hierarchy to be effective

  • Not a stepping stone you can coast through. The exposure is real, and so is the pace

🚀 Why This Role Is Different

Most assistant roles are about keeping someone else's life tidy. This one is about making a company move faster.

You'll own hiring coordination, which at our stage is one of the highest-leverage things we do — the people you help bring in will shape what Outpost becomes. And you'll get a front-row view of a Series A fintech being built, with two people above you invested in teaching you how it works.

We expect whoever is in this role to grow rapidly, and we'll back you every step of the way.

🦾 Outpost Team

Our team were leaders at Revolut, Airwallex, Adyen, Sumup and Wayflyer - and we're backed by top-tier investors who have built or backed some of the world's leading fintechs.

🧾 What We Offer

  • Equity and salary in a well-funded startup

  • Ability to own your work and move fast

  • World-class training from operators who've scaled globally

  • A global mission with real impact

  • Low politics, high output

  • Chance to grow into a senior role fast

  • A culture of builders, not talkers
